title: Payer Coverage Matrix for Strip Notices: Treatment Class and Active CGM Program
content:
For a liability notice for test strips on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, the coverage the notice is sized against depends on the customer's treatment class and on whether the customer holds an active Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program.

**Matrix rule.** The coverage is the lower of the tier's insulin-treated allowance and its with-CGM allowance for an insulin-treated customer who holds an active CGM program, the lower of the tier's not-insulin-treated allowance and its with-CGM allowance for a customer not treated with insulin who holds an active CGM program, the tier's insulin-treated allowance for an insulin-treated customer who holds no active CGM program, and the tier's not-insulin-treated allowance for a customer not treated with insulin who holds no active CGM program. A CGM program that is on hold, closed or not yet active (referral received or pending authorization) is not an active CGM program.

| | Holds an active CGM program | Holds no active CGM program |
|---|---|---|
| Insulin-treated | lower of insulin-treated and with-CGM allowances | insulin-treated allowance |
| Not treated with insulin | lower of not-insulin-treated and with-CGM allowances | not-insulin-treated allowance |

**The allowances, per rolling 90 days, and the coverage each cell gives**

| Tier | Insulin-treated | Not insulin-treated | With CGM | Insulin, active CGM | Not insulin, active CGM | Insulin, no active CGM | Not insulin, no active CGM |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 1200 | 1200 | 1200 | 1200 | 1200 | 1200 | 1200 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 450 | 150 | 150 | 150 | 150 | 450 | 150 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 600 | 200 | 150 | 150 | 150 | 600 | 200 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 300 | 100 | 300 | 300 | 100 | 300 | 100 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 300 | 100 | 300 | 300 | 100 | 300 | 100 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 450 | 100 | 150 | 150 | 100 | 450 | 100 |

The treatment class is read from the testing supplies program; the CGM status from the customer's CGM program record.
